headline: SK Hynix Shares Powers South Korea’s KOSPI to Record High - The Bull
summary: South Korea's KOSPI rose 2.72% to an all-time closing high of 6,388.47 on Tuesday. Semiconductor stocks led the rally, with SK Hynix among the technology heavyweights driving gains.
why: SK Hynix is a leading memory chip maker, and the KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductors.
